answer: Every epoch, a public lottery draws a random slice of identities for a deep audit — a mesa of open ground no farm can hide behind. The draw is seeded after identities commit, so no one knows who is picked until it is too late to rehearse. An honest agent passes with the work it already did, at the cost of one audit. A farm's timber — its thousand cheap fakes — must each stand audit-ready each epoch, or one failed check burns its whole cluster. A single zephyr of suspicion, one failed proof, triggers a full re-audit of every identity the fake ever vouched for.
